rationale: Executive Order 13244 (December 18, 2001) was revoked in its entirety by section 4 of Executive Order 13915 of April 14, 2020 (85 FR 21733), whose held Federal Register text says Executive Order 13244 is hereby revoked; the held 5 U.S.C. 3345 note gives the same revocation and date. The only intervening instrument, Executive Order 13261 (March 19, 2002), amended section 3(a) and did not end the order. The order has no sunset or condition that ended it earlier, and EO 13915 itself restates the succession rule without reviving EO 13244. The catalog observation (Revokes: EO 11487; Amended by: EO 13261) and the three candidate events (two for the amendment and one for the revocation) were each checked against the held texts. The order has no operative force on 2026-10-14.
